entities.name: Evan
entities.description: One of the two friends in this conversation, a father who talks to Sam every few weeks between May 2023 and January 2024. Watercolour painter of several years' standing, keen hiker, skier and gym-goer, Prius driver and owner of a bonsai tree and a fitness watch. Over the conversation he has a heart-palpitation scare, twists his knee twice, meets a Canadian woman in August 2023 and marries her in December 2023, loses his job to a company downsizing in October 2023, and learns his wife is pregnant in December 2023. He grew up on a small island and keeps a favourite sunset spot by the beach near his home.

entities.name: Sam
entities.description: The other friend in this conversation, whose running thread is his weight and health. Doctors warn him in May 2023 and again on 2 October 2023 that his weight is a serious risk; he is diagnosed with gastritis in October 2023, starts a diet and exercise routine on 21 August 2023 and becomes a Weight Watchers coach in his group on 9 November 2023. He takes a cooking class, journals and does creative writing, sketches occasionally, takes up morning running by the end of 2023, and repeatedly has trouble with supermarket self-checkouts and with his new phone.

entities.name: Evan's wife, the Canadian woman he met in August 2023

properties.aliases: the Canadian woman; my new SO; my partner; my wife

entities.description: The woman Evan met on a trip to Canada in the week before 7 August 2023 and describes as making him feel alive. They holidayed in Canada together in August 2023, married in the week before 26 December 2023, told their extended family on 5 January 2024, tried snowshoeing over the weekend of 6-7 January 2024 and planned a February 2024 honeymoon in Canada. Evan announced on 9 December 2023 that she was pregnant. Never named in the conversation; referred to as the Canadian woman, his new SO, his partner and his wife.

entities.name: Evan's son
entities.description: Evan's son, the subject of two accidents Evan reports: a soccer accident on 12 August 2023 that hurt his ankle, and a fall from his bike on 12 December 2023 that left him on crutches. He recovered well from both. Never named.

entities.name: Evan's family
entities.description: The group Evan means by 'my family' — his children (including the son who had two accidents) and, from December 2023, his wife. They take a Rockies trip in May 2023, a road trip to Jasper over 20-21 May 2023, a mountain drive in the Prius in December 2023, and hold a lasagne get-together on 6 January 2024. Evan says they motivate him to stay healthy, keeps a collage of family memories with a 'Bring it on Home' sign from their Banff trip as a family motto, and was planning a big family reunion for the summer of 2024.

entities.name: Sam's father
entities.description: Sam's father, who took him on a long hike when Sam was about ten years old; Sam calls it a great and special memory and the reason he loves hiking. Mentioned only in this context and never named.

entities.name: The friend who got Evan into painting
entities.description: An unnamed friend of Evan's who introduced him to watercolour painting a few years before 2023, gave him advice, and gave him a painting that inspired him to start painting himself. Referred to in May 2023 as 'my friend' and in August 2023 as 'a friend of mine'; these two mentions are joined here because both describe the same origin of his painting.

entities.name: The Rocky Mountains
entities.description: The mountain range Evan visited twice in 2023: a family trip in the week before 18 May 2023 on which they hiked the trails, and a solo road trip in the month before 27 August 2023 that he found refreshing and relaxing.

entities.name: Jasper
entities.description: The destination of the road trip Evan took his family on over the weekend of 20-21 May 2023, driving the Icefields Parkway past glaciers and lakes and staying in a cabin surrounded by mountains and forests. Sam has never been there.

entities.name: Canada
entities.description: Where Evan met his future wife on a trip in the week before 7 August 2023, where the two of them holidayed together in August 2023 camping, hiking and biking, and where they planned to honeymoon in February 2024 to ski, eat local food and see the snowy landscapes. Evan intended to try poutine there.

entities.name: Banff
entities.description: Where Evan went skiing on a drive in the month before 19 August 2023, saying the snow was amazing and he could not wait to go back the next year. An earlier family trip to Banff is where the 'Bring it on Home' sign in Evan's family memory collage came from.

entities.name: Lake Tahoe
entities.description: Where Sam and a friend were travelling on 14 October 2023 to try kayaking, having heard it was great for it; Evan said they would love the clear water and views.

entities.name: Evan's favourite spot by the beach

properties.aliases: my favorite spot by the beach; this peaceful place close to my home

entities.description: A peaceful place close to Evan's home where he often goes to relax and unwind and to watch the sunset over the waves; he says it helps him find peace during tough times. He photographed the sunset there on 3 November 2023 and he and Sam agreed on 9 November 2023 to visit it together, planning it for the following month. Unnamed in the conversation.

entities.name: The island where Evan grew up
entities.description: A small island Evan grew up on and calls his happy place, shown to Sam in photographs on 21 November 2023. Evan says it shaped him, will always hold a special place in his heart, and feels like a slice of paradise. Unnamed in the conversation.

entities.name: Evan's gym
entities.description: The gym Evan belongs to; he keeps his membership card as a reminder of the commitment he made when he turned his health around. He lifts weights there, was there on 16 October 2023 gaining strength, and said on 21 November 2023 that hitting the gym is how he stays in shape. Unnamed in the conversation.

entities.name: Sam's cooking class
entities.description: A cooking class Sam was taking as of 15 August 2023 to learn to make healthier meals. He learned several recipes there, cooked a grilled marinated fish dish with vegetables on the evening of 14 August 2023, and offered Evan a roasted vegetable recipe from it.

entities.name: Evan's painting classes
entities.description: Painting classes Evan started a few days before 19 August 2023, joining to meet like-minded people and improve his skills. The classes cover watercolours and the instructor stresses observing nature and painting what you see; Evan finds them a relaxing break from everyday stress.

entities.name: Weight Watchers
entities.description: The weight-loss programme Sam takes part in. He was made a coach in his group by 9 November 2023, which he called a big accomplishment and a step in his quest for better health, and he attended a meeting on 4 December 2023 that he found insightful.

entities.name: The company Evan worked for until October 2023
entities.description: Evan's employer until it downsized and made him redundant in October 2023, which he told Sam about on 9 November 2023. He was job-hunting without much luck afterwards. Unnamed in the conversation.

entities.name: The Great Gatsby

properties.aliases: that new mystery novel; that book I was talking about

entities.description: The novel Evan was reading in the second half of 2023. He described it on 27 July 2023 as a gripping new mystery novel he could not stop thinking about and named it when Sam asked; on 27 August 2023 he said it got better with every page and he could not put it down. Sam said he would read it sometime.

entities.name: The Godfather
entities.description: The film Sam watched on the evening of 9 January 2024; he found the line 'I'm gonna make him an offer he can't refuse' motivating for sticking to his health routine, and Evan called it a legendary watch that bears re-watching.

entities.name: Evan's cactus painting
entities.description: A watercolour of a cactus in the desert that Evan showed Sam on 18 May 2023 and again on 6 October 2023, when he said it was inspired by a road trip in the month before. Sam called it impressive.

entities.name: Evan's sunset painting
entities.description: A painting of a sunset over the ocean that Evan showed Sam on 19 August 2023 as one of his recent works, and which on 6 October 2023 he said was inspired by a vacation a few years earlier. The mention in August and the one in October are joined here because both describe one sunset painting he had already finished; the sunset painting he finished on 14 October 2023 is recorded separately as an event, since nothing says it is this one.

entities.name: Evan's contemporary figurative painting
entities.description: A contemporary figurative painting Evan finished a few days before 17 December 2023, using expressive brushwork and vibrant colour to capture a moment of introspection. He was very proud of it, and a close friend helped him get it published in an exhibition.

entities.name: Evan's new Prius
entities.description: The Prius Evan bought to replace his old one before May 2023. He took his family to the Rockies in it, relies on it for his active lifestyle and road trips, and it broke down on 5 December 2023, which he found a real stressor. The family still took it on a long mountain drive over the weekend of 23-24 December 2023, on which they had a minor accident on the way back.

entities.name: Evan's old Prius
entities.description: The Prius Evan had before the new one. It broke down, and he decided to have it repaired so he could sell it, replacing it with the new Prius before 18 May 2023.

entities.name: Evan's fitness watch
entities.description: A fitness watch Evan wears that tracks his progress and serves as a constant visual reminder to keep going with his health goals. He showed it to Sam on 7 August 2023 and Sam was considering ordering a similar one.

entities.name: Evan's 1968 Kustom K-200A guitar
entities.description: A 1968 Kustom K-200A vintage guitar Evan received as a gift from a close friend and showed Sam on 9 November 2023, during the rough patch after he lost his job. Sam thought it looked vintage and cool.

entities.name: Evan's bonsai tree
entities.description: A bonsai tree Evan keeps because it symbolises strength and resilience; caring for it motivates him to keep going through tough times and reminds him that toughness shows in little things. Shown to Sam on 7 August 2023.

entities.name: Evan's keys
entities.description: Evan's house keys, a running joke between the two. He spent half an hour hunting for them on 13 August 2023 and said he loses them every week; he lost them again on 26 December 2023 and called it a weekly ritual, prompting Sam to suggest fitting a GPS sensor to them.

entities.name: Sam's new phone
entities.description: A new phone Sam had by October 2023 whose navigation app kept malfunctioning, making it hard to get around. Evan suggested updating it. It was still giving Sam trouble on 17 October 2023 and adding to his stress.

entities.name: Watercolour painting
entities.description: Evan's long-standing hobby, taken up a few years before 2023 after a friend introduced him to it and gave him a painting. He calls it a stress-buster and a way of expressing feelings without words, paints landscapes and whatever is on his mind, and took formal classes from August 2023. Sam repeatedly said he wanted to try painting to de-stress and the two planned a session together for 16 September 2023.

entities.name: Hiking
entities.description: An activity both men value. Evan hikes often, hiked the Rockies trails with his family in May 2023 and in Canada in August 2023, and says a thirst for adventure on interesting hikes motivates him. Sam hiked with his father at about age ten, had not hiked in years by 2023, took friends on a hiking trip on 29 December 2023, and he and Evan repeatedly agreed to hike together.

entities.name: Kayaking
entities.description: Suggested by Evan to Sam on 14 October 2023 as a fun, active way to get exercise outdoors. Sam and a friend set off to try it at Lake Tahoe the same day, and Evan offered to plan a kayaking trip together at a spot of his choosing. Evan himself kayaked and watched the sunset on a camping trip in the summer of 2023.

entities.name: Skiing
entities.description: One of the winter sports Evan enjoys, along with snowboarding and ice skating. He skied at Banff in the month before 19 August 2023 and hoped to return the next year, and skiing was part of the plan for the February 2024 honeymoon in Canada. Sam would like to try it but doubts his body could take it.

entities.name: Yoga
entities.description: Suggested between the two as gentle, effective exercise. Sam said on 5 December 2023 that yoga had done wonders for his flexibility and stress levels; Evan, who had been thinking about trying it, took it up and said on 10 January 2024 that it had helped him with stress and staying flexible alongside his diet, and recommended it to Sam as a low-impact exercise.

entities.name: Sam's journal and creative writing
entities.description: How Sam expresses himself. He keeps a journal and does creative writing, which he finds therapeutic and describes as a way of sorting out his feelings and having a conversation with himself. He also sketches occasionally but said on 26 December 2023 that he had not yet made anything remarkable.

entities.name: Evan's health and fitness routine
entities.description: The diet and exercise regime Evan has kept up since about 2021: a fitness routine he genuinely enjoys, weight training started around October 2022, morning walks, cutting sugary snacks and eating more vegetables and fruit. He said on 7 August 2023 he had been working on it for two years with ups and downs, credits letting go of quick-result expectations, and is motivated by his family and his fitness watch. On 6 January 2024 he added a limit of two ginger snaps a day, ginger snaps being his admitted weakness.

entities.name: Sam's diet and exercise routine
entities.description: Sam's attempt to change how he eats and exercises, which runs through the whole conversation. He made no changes at all in June 2023, was cutting soda and candy by late July, announced a diet on 19 August 2023, started a new diet and exercise routine on 21 August 2023 and felt more energetic, posted before-and-after photographs in September, relapsed with snacks in October, kept going under family pressure, became a Weight Watchers coach in November, took up morning running by late December, and drew up a meal plan and workout schedule to start on 10 January 2024.

entities.name: Sam's weight
entities.description: The health problem that dominates Sam's side of the conversation. A doctor's check-up a few days before 24 May 2023 showed his weight was not good; on 2 October 2023 a doctor told him it was a serious health risk that would get worse without change. Friends mocked it on 21 July 2023, it limited his movement by November 2023, and by 17 December 2023 he said it was hurting his confidence and he lacked the motivation to overcome it. On 11 January 2024 he said it felt like it was keeping him from fully living.

entities.name: Sam's gastritis
entities.description: Diagnosed after Sam went to the emergency room with a severe stomachache over the weekend of 14-15 October 2023. He found it alarming and took it as a wake-up call to adopt a more nutritious diet and exercise regularly.

entities.name: Evan's knee injury
entities.description: Evan twisted his knee on 25 August 2023, which made it painful to keep up his usual fitness routine; he swam and kept things low-key while waiting for physiotherapy. He hurt the same knee again in the week before 6 October 2023 playing basketball with his children. By 6 October physiotherapy had helped some, and he was doing easy exercises rather than intense workouts.

entities.name: Evan's heart palpitations
entities.description: A sudden heart palpitation incident Evan had in the week before 6 June 2023 that shook him badly and served as a wake-up call about his lifestyle; he was carrying medication and became extra careful about processed food and sugary snacks afterwards.
